mentl/d797c8a:
The affine ledger consumed at every use of an `own` value, so a value read
in an `if` condition (`if set_contains(buf, x)`) and then used in the arms
counted as consumed twice — but the condition is READ to decide control, and
buf is never moved out of it. Same for a `match` scrutinee.

A borrow_depth counter on affine_ledger, bracketed by borrow_enter /
borrow_exit around the condition and the scrutinee, drops consumes while
inside: a read is a borrow. Carried-Truth — the graph already knows a
condition is a read; the ledger treated it as a move.

Cleared 32 of the 37 remaining "consumed twice" (census 615 -> 583) with
soundness intact: a real double-move `(take(buf), take(buf))` to two `own`
parameters is still caught. Emit grew (the counter + two ops) so a clean
m2 == m3 transition, boot re-pinned. The frontier fixture gains a
condition-borrow case (four false consumes on the old boot, a clean run to
33 on this one).

Residue (5): the field-read (`buf.data` + `buf.count`) and the sequential
call-arg-borrow (`len(nodes)` then `list_copy_into(nodes)`) — the remaining
move-vs-borrow needs a field-receiver borrow and the callee-param ownership
at each call argument, so a borrowing parameter does not consume its arg.

noodles/d712e3c:
Follow-up pass on D30, mostly correcting my own work.

**Undo could revert what it could never record.** Widening snapshots to
{song, mix, devices} without giving mixer and device edits their own undo
points made a new trap: move a fader, undo an older note edit, and the
fader went back with it. Every knob in the app is now an undo point,
coalesced to one per drag inside knob() itself — snapshot on pointerdown,
commit on pointerup only if the value moved, the shape the groove/human
sliders and the drum drag already used. Mute, solo, the resets, the morph
pad, colour chips, bank/source switches, the per-track sound dice and the
one-shot pins push one each; a reset that touches four strips pushes one
for the sweep. The master bus joins the snapshot: D22 keeps it out of
project FILES, which is about persistence, not about taking back a move,
and its knobs sit in the same sheet as strips that are undoable.

**markTouched moved from pushUndo into commitUndo.** Nine gesture-
coalesced commits — the drum drag, the piano-roll drags, and the new
knob/fader/pad ones — recorded real edits that the service-worker swap
still read as an untouched session, safe to reload out from under the
player. The groove and human sliders had each patched around it by hand.

**The harnesses never exited.** `npm run preview` spawns vite as a
grandchild, so killing the npm shell left it holding the port AND the
inherited stdout pipe, which kept Node's event loop alive: every run hung
after its last assertion (smoke exited 124 under a timeout wrapper, every
time) and leaked a server. A session of runs had left 37 of them alive.
The child is now spawned detached and stop() signals the process group.
smoke.mjs and calibrate.mjs kept private copies of startPreview, so the
one bug lived in three files — they now import scripts/preview.mjs like
audit.mjs already did. Both gates exit 0 and leave nothing behind.

**Smoke now holds these contracts**: a roll must be undoable whole, a
mixer move must be it
